transcript.text: I can help with that. The most common reason for this is an unbalanced load (e.g., a single heavy item like a duvet or bath mat sticking to one side), which causes the machine to abort the spin to protect itself. Another very common cause is that it hasn't drained the water yet, as machines won't spin if there's still water in the drum. To narrow this down, please run a drain or spin-only programme and listen near the bottom front of the machine while it tries to pump out. Does the water pump away, and can you hear the pump humming or is it silent?
